"""
Abstract translator interfaces for siuba operations.

This module provides abstract base classes that can be used to reduce coupling
between different parts of the translation system.
"""

from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Protocol

class ITranslator(Protocol):
    """Protocol for translation operations."""
    
    def translate(self, expr, window: bool = True):
        """Translate an expression."""
        ...

class AbstractTranslator(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for translators.
    
    This interface can be used to decouple translation logic from specific
    implementations, enabling better separation of concerns.
    """
    
    @abstractmethod
    def translate(self, expr, window: bool = True):
        """Translate an expression.
        
        Parameters
        ----------
        expr :
            The expression to translate
        window : bool
            Whether to use window context
        """
        pass
